name: @opensymbols/cli
description: Generate an icon package from your own SF Symbols catalog.

scripts.build: tsup src/main.ts src/generate/assemble.ts --format esm --clean && node scripts/copy-demo.mjs
scripts.prepack: node ../../scripts/check-pack.mjs --require-pnpm && pnpm --filter demo... build && pnpm --filter @opensymbols/cli... build && node ../../scripts/check-pack.mjs --package .
